president.name: Sarah Adegbite & Maryam Khan
president.bio: Hello! We are Sarah and Maryam, your JCR co-presidents for 2022. We are both second years studying Theology and HSPS and are super excited about representing the John's student body and pushing for change. We want to improve key aspects of college life, with an emphasis on access and welfare, and another key goal we have is to ensure the smooth running of both the JCR Committee and the events we host throughout the year. We attend lots of important meetings and put forward proposals that will work to implement ideas from the John's community. We've had the time of our lives at John's so far and want to make the college the best it can be for everyone. We are always open and receptive to new ideas and could talk about John's and the JCR for absolutely ages (it's literally our only personality trait), so please don't hesitate to get in touch. You can email us, shoot across on social media, or just stop us for a chat if you see us around college - here's to an amazing year!

vicepresident.name: Christian Suen
vicepresident.bio: Heya! I'm Christian, a second year HSPSer and your VP for the year. With this being my second year on the JCR, I'm especially hyped for the year to come! My main big focus is fresher's week, making sure that it continues to be the best opportunity for first years to settle in and feel more at home at John's. Beyond this, I want to work with Sarah and Maryam in pushing college to increase their recognition of minority groups on campus, as well as ensure a smooth functioning JCR committee. I'm super easy to find on Instagram, so just drop me a message anytime! Or feel free to watch a few of my TikToks with the previous JCR ;) (@ christian.suen / cmcs4).

access.name: Felix Haynes
access.bio: Hi! I'm Felix, a third year studying HSPS, and your Access Officer! Part of my role involves working with the Admissions Office, Admissions Tutor, and the JCR to ensure John's is accessible to prospective students from a range of backgrounds, and sharing opportunities for current students to get involved (you can find out more about these in the John's Access group!). The other part of my role focuses on post-admission access, providing advice and resources to current students, and ensuring college remains a place where everyone is supported. Outside of the JCR, I help to run access initiatives for the wider university, and am involved with various fundraising initiatives in Cambridge. Please do get in touch if you have any concerns, or are interested in getting involved with access at John's!

bme.name: Annissa La Touche
bme.bio: Hi! I'm Annissa, a first year Geography student and Ethnic Minorities Officer from now until the end of Michaelmas Term 2022! I want to continue creating an environment at John's where students from any and every ethnic minority feel recognised and advocated for. As well as this, I envision John's being a place where various cultures are celebrated by all of the student body - building on the amazing sense of community we already have here. I'm also always here if you want to reach out with any questions, suggestions or concerns!

computing.name: Jan Derlatka
computing.bio: Hi, I'm Jan, a first year Engineering student and your Computing Officer for this year! I'm involved in University ski racing, train triathlon and before coming to Cambridge I had studied Computer Science for a year. As Computing Officer I am responsible for technical aspects of the JCR operation, right now I am developing an online ticketing system for JCR events. If you have any ideas on what else we could create I will be more than happy to hear from you! I also act as a connection between the student body and the IT department, ensuring that important improvements desired by students, are acted upon.

disabilities.name: Bertie Titley
disabilities.bio: Hi! I'm Bertie and I will be your Disabilities Officer for the next year. Cambridge is a really exciting place to be with so many opportunities and a disability shouldn't stop anyone from enjoying them. I hope I can help with any queries that you may have about anything from room allocations to exam arrangements, even if I don't know immediately we can definitely get through it together! I'm also keen to make college events and facilities as accessible as possible and welcome suggestions and feedback. Can't wait to work with you all in the coming year!

ents.name: Marcel Bedeau
ents.bio: Hey! I'm Marcel, a second year HSPSer and this year's Ents Officer! My role is basically centred around organising all of the social events for Johnians throughout the year. From organising themed parties and performances to ordering drinks and selling tickets, I am the person that ensures that you have a good time. I'm also here to ensure that the social needs of all Johnians are catered for, so if you have any questions or queries get in touch! :)

ethical.name: Ed Lucas
ethical.bio: Hi, I'm Ed - your environmental and charitable affairs officer for this year! I'm a second year studying Biological Natural Sciences, and an enthusiastic mixed netball and lacrosse player. Championing the efforts of charitable organisations among the St John's undergraduate community is central to my role, as well as supporting initiatives for more environmentally sustainable practices. If you have thoughts on how we can improve our environmentalism at John's, suggestions for events or ideas for initiatives you want to discuss, feel free to get in touch!

equalops.name: Arefin Haque
equalops.bio: Hey Guys! I'm Arefin, a Second year Medic and your first ever JCR Class Act Officer! I'm also Co-Captain of the St Johns Ultimate Frisbee team. As Class Act Officer, I want to ensure everyone coming from a disadvantaged background feels welcome, safe, and happy studying at Johns. Part of my role also includes making sure all students are aware of the support that St Johns has to offer, as well as acting as a friendly point of contact for any questions or concerns you may have. I'll also be working with the JCR Access officer to ensure pre-admissions events are adequately inclusive of those from disadvantaged backgrounds. If you have any suggestions for me, or would just like a chat, please don't hesitate to approach me if you see me walking around college, or alternatively, drop me an email at ah2164!

internationals.name: Samson Chan
internationals.bio: Hi! I'm Samson, a first-year law student from Hong Kong. I'm so excited to represent you as your internationals officer this year. My role involves advocating for international students on the JCR committee and providing them with support. For example, I'll be organising international freshers' week in September.  I know that international students can face unique challenges at university, especially due to the pandemic. I want to be a friendly point of contact so don't hesitate to reach out via social media or in person if you've got any questions or concerns - I'm always around to help!

lgbtq.name: Sam Hewson
lgbtq.bio: Hi, I'm Sam(he/him), a second year NatSci and I'm your LGBTQ+ officer. My main aim this year is to make everyone feel welcome at John's and within the community. I'm really excited to be hosting lots of events throughout the year including the long-awaited rainbow formals. Feel free to contact me at any time, and make sure to check the JCR Facebook page for updates.

mentalhealth.name: Yusuf Adia
mentalhealth.bio: Hi! I'm Yusuf, yet another second-year medic on the JCR, and your Mental Health Officer for this year. Cambridge and various pressures seem to go hand in hand and so I want to make it clear that it is normal to not be feeling our best. My roles involve supporting the mental health of the students across college and fostering positive discussions about mental health. So, what can you expect from me? Firstly, you can contact me directly, either in-person or via message, for support – I'm always up for a chat! Secondly, I'll be working to raise awareness of the different avenues of support available to students and will try and improve access to support. Finally, I'll be talking directly to college management about issues the student body faces so please let me know of any concerns you have so I can relay them onwards! I'll also be working closely with our welfare officers, Jai and Bernice, to host fun events as well as drop-in sessions. Once again, you're more than welcome to get in touch!

publicity.name: Zahir Shah
publicity.bio: Hi, I'm Zahir, your JCR publicity officer for this year! When I'm not preoccupied screaming my lungs out to All Too We'll (10 Minute Version) for the whole of New Court to hear - sorry Yusuf xoxo - I take part in the college badminton and rowing while also working as a student ambassador. My role is to maintain the social media pages for the JCR (Facebook and Instagram) as well as sending out the weekly bulletin to keep all Johnians informed and up to date on college life. Feel free to send me an email with anything you think should be included in either the bulletin or on the socials and I'll make sure to share it. I'm always on my phone (it's part of the job) so please feel free to message me with any feedback or suggestions you may have!

secretary.name: Ray Hector
secretary.bio: Hi, I'm Ray, a second-year Geographer at St John's! I am the JCR Secretary for 2022 and it is my role to ensure the JCR Committee's meetings, plans, motions, and general happenings are available in clear, concise, and (somewhat) exciting formats. Please find the agendas and minutes for meetings on the JCR website or subscribe to a mailing list to be kept up to date. They can also be found physically (in the JCR Common Room on the noticeboard) or virtually (through the use of the virtual noticeboard). Away from the JCR Committee, I enjoy playing a variety of college and university sports (especially Ultimate which I co-captain) as well as getting involved with playing Go, watching films, and walking. Please feel free to contact me about my role on the JCR or just in general regarding college and university life. I'm more than happy to answer questions and have a chat!

services.name: Jacob Davies
services.bio: Hi, I'm Jacob, your JCR Sports, Services and Societies Officer for 2022. I am a second year Linguistics Student. I play Football with the Poulets and Hockey with the Mogs. I am also a member of the University Mountaineering Society and Digital Gaming Society. I have found that Sports and Societies are what make both Cambridge and Johns the experience that it is, and I want to make sure that everyone is able to find their passion and enjoy themselves in their time here. As well as Sports and Societies I am also in charge of  Services and Facilities which includes the JCR room, Liaising with the Catering team, the laundry and the Gym. If you have any questions, suggestions or if you want to start/join a society please drop me an email or text.

treasurer.name: William Shaw
treasurer.bio: Hi everyone, I'm William, a second-year econ and I'm this year's JCR Treasurer. In my free time, I really enjoy working on access issues at Cambridge, as a college student ambassador, as a Cambassador and with external charities. My main responsibilities this year as Treasurer include keeping track of the JCR finances and managing the budgets of the rest of the JCR committee members. This year, I really want to focus on transparency, so don't hesitate at all to reach out to me with any questions about how the JCR runs its finances. You can send me an email or a message at any time, or just catch me around the college.

mnb.name: Jai Pantling
mnb.bio: Hi everyone! I'm Jai, your male and non-binary welfare officer. I'm a second-year medical student from Manchester, who also enjoys running and playing college hockey. My fellow welfare team and I hope to continue the fantastic work of last year's team, bringing about significant and tangible change in college. This coming year, I hope to show just how dependable and approachable I am, so please do come to me if you think I can help with anything (big or small)! I'll also be working hard with the rest of the welfare ream (Yusuf and Bernice) to run fun events to keep the gloom away. In the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact me, whether you just need someone to talk to or indeed you have more serious issues that need to be dealt with.

fnb.name: Bernice Cheung
fnb.bio: Hello! I'm Bernice, your Female and Non-Binary Welfare Officer this year. I'm a first-year law student from Hong Kong, and am involved with college ultimate frisbee and football. My role involves representing and supporting students' welfare at St. John's and liaising with the college on welfare-related issues. Along with Jai and Yusuf, we organise regular welfare events to keep college life happy and help you de-stress. We also provide free and anonymous sexual health supplies and sanitary products in college. I am always open to suggestions for any welfare events you would like us to organise and am always available if you need someone to talk to!

gender.name: Neha Manoj
gender.bio: Hey - I'm Neha and I'm a first year Law student! I'm so pleased to introduce myself as your Gender Equality officer this year! Through committing to manage the Consent Johns campaign, staying heavily involved in more Feminist Society events and also directing raised awareness towards male mental health issues as we leave Movember behind us are all top priorities. Ensuring that consent, mental health and gender identity and equality are issues that can be discussed whenever and wherever provides the forefront ideology behind this entire role. I really want to see our college continue and grow to be a healthy warm and extremely open environment and I recognise that promoting an approachable atmosphere is the primary step to making that happen - so please know that I am always free. Be it suggestions, ideas, queries or complaints - just give me a shout! :)
